sn51.20:1.1: bhikkhave iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā || ||
sn51.20:2.1: Katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā || || 3.
sn51.20:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.20:2.3: Iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati || na ca atipaggahīto bhavissati || na ca ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto bhavissati || na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati ||
sn51.20:2.8: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsam cittam bhāveti ||
sn51.20:2.12: Iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati || na ca atipaggahītā bhavissati || na ca ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittā bhavissati na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati ||
sn51.20:2.14: yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure ||
sn51.20:2.15: yatha adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho ||
sn51.20:2.16: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā ||
sn51.20:2.17: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittam bhāveti || || 4.
sn51.20:5.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto chando || ||
sn51.20:5.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto chando || || 7.
sn51.20:6.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhitto chando ||
sn51.20:6.2: yo bhikkhave chando bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhito anuvisaṭo ||
sn51.20:6.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhitto chando || || 8.
sn51.20:7.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati
sn51.20:7.2: yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathāpure || ||
sn51.20:7.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pacchāpure saññā suggahītā hoti sumanasikatā supadhāritā suppaṭividdhā paññāya ||
sn51.20:7.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pacchāpure saññī ca viharati
sn51.20:7.5: yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure || || 9.
sn51.20:8.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddham yatha uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati || ||
sn51.20:8.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyam uddham pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantam pūram nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati ||
sn51.20:8.3: Atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakam pihakam papphāsam antaṃ antaguṇam udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghānikā kasikā muttan ti || ||
sn51.20:8.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati || || 10.
sn51.20:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati || ||
sn51.20:9.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || ||
sn51.20:9.3: Yehi vā pana ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || ||
sn51.20:9.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati || || 11.
sn51.20:10.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittam bhāveti || ||
sn51.20:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ālokasaññā suggahītā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā || ||
sn51.20:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsam cittam bhāveti || || 12.
sn51.20:13.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittaṃ viriyaṃ || || 15.
sn51.20:14.2: Yam bhikkhave viriyaṃ bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittam anuvisaṭaṃ || || Idam vuccati bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ viriyaṃ || || 16--19. Peyyālo || ||
sn51.20:15.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsam bhāveti || ||
sn51.20:15.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ālokasaññā sugahitā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā || ||
sn51.20:15.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭen cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittam bhāveti || || 20.
sn51.20:16.2: yam pi bhikkhave cittaṃ kosajjasahagataṃ kosajjasampayuttaṃ ||
sn51.20:18.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittaṃ cittaṃ || || 23.
sn51.20:19.2: Yam bhikkhave cittam bahiddhā pañcaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittam anuvisaṭaṃ ||
sn51.20:19.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ || || 24--27. Peyyālam ||
sn51.20:19.4: evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti || ||
sn51.20:20.1: V. 28. Katamā ca bhikkhave atilīṇā vīmaṃsā || ||
sn51.20:23.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā || ||
sn51.20:23.2: Yā bhikkhave vīmaṃsā bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittā anuvisaṭā ||
sn51.20:23.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā || || 32--35. la || ||
sn51.20:23.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsam cittam bhāveti || || 36.
sn51.20:23.5: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā ||
sn51.20:24.1: evam bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave bhikkhu catusu iddhipādesu evam bahulīkatesu anekavihitam iddhividham paccanubhoti || || Eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti || bahudhā pi hutvā eko hoti || la || yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti || pe || || 37.
sn51.20:24.2: Evam bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave bhikkhu catusu iddhipādesu evam bahulīkatesu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttim diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti || || 38. Cha
sn51.20:25.4: Desanā Vibhaṅgena cā ti || || 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Pubbe
